metadata.methods_description: Subjects underwent localization tests using pink noise bursts from loudspeakers at various elevations and a fixed azimuth. In Experiment I (deviant detection), subjects heard a long adapter noise from one loudspeaker followed by a short probe noise from another loudspeaker at different elevations, and behavioral responses to deviants were recorded. In Experiment II (one-back task), subjects heard white noise through open headphones followed by a noise burst from a loudspeaker at varying elevations, with occasional target trials requiring localization responses.
